  function bit
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::get_prop_val
 (  string prop_name , ref bit [1023:0] prop_val , input int array_ix , ref svt_sequence_item_base data_obj  ) 

This method is used by a component's command interface, to allow command code to retrieve the value of a single named property of a data class derived from this class. If the prop_name argument does not match a property of the class, or if the array_ix argument is not zero and does not point to a valid array element, this function returns '0'. Otherwise it returns '1', with the value of the prop_val argument assigned to the value of the specified property. However, If the property is a sub-object, a reference to it is assigned to the data_obj (ref) argument.

prop_name - The name of a property in this class, or a derived class.

prop_val - A ref argument used to return the current value of the property, expressed as a 1024 bit quantity. When returning a string value each character requires 8 bits so returned strings must be 128 characters or less.

array_ix - If the property is an array, this argument specifies the index being accessed. If the property is not an array, it should be set to 0.

data_obj - If the property is not a sub-object, this argument is assigned to null. If the property is a sub-object, a reference to it is assigned to this (ref) argument. In that case, the prop_val argument is meaningless. The component will then store the data object reference in its temporary data object array, and return a handle to its location as the prop_val argument of the get_data_prop task of the component. The command testbench code must then use that handle to access the properties of the sub-object.

Return values - A single bit representing whether or not a valid property was retrieved.

  function bit
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::set_prop_val
 (  string prop_name , bit [1023:0] prop_val , int array_ix  ) 

This method is used by a component's command interface, to allow command code to set the value of a single named property of a data class derived from this class. This method cannot be used to set the value of a sub-object, since sub-object construction is taken care of automatically by the command interface. If the prop_name argument does not match a property of the class, or it matches a sub-object of the class, or if the array_ix argument is not zero and does not point to a valid array element, this function returns '0'. Otherwise it returns '1'.

prop_name - The name of a property in this class, or a derived class.

prop_val - The value to assign to the property, expressed as a 1024 bit quantity. When assigning a string value each character requires 8 bits so assigned strings must be 128 characters or less.

array_ix - If the property is an array, this argument specifies the index being accessed. If the property is not an array, it should be set to 0.

Return values - A single bit representing whether or not a valid property was set.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::bta_inprocess = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indicates that BTA in process for respective lane. ta-look state will set this flag. ta-ack or ta-look or stop state will reset the flag based on various condition. This flag helps Rx-FSM stop state to decide whether this stop state transition is in between the BTA process or not.
  • 0 : BTA not in process. Reset at stop state or ta-ack state or when time-out indicated at ta-look state.
  • 1 : BTA in process. This was set after TA-SURE duration.
  • Default value is 0.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::bta_timeout = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indicates that BTA timeout had happened in respective lane. This indication comes from upper layer when BTA acknowledgement was not received in the expected time duration once the BTA request was sent. set(1) and reset(0) of this flag is done by upper layer only.
  • 0 : No BTA timeout happened.
  • 1 : BTA timeout happened.
  • Default value is 0.

 svt_mipi_cphy_status::force_rx_mode = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indication from APP that it is setting the device in receive mode. The APP side PPI layer uses this variable to assert and de-assert the force_rx_mode signal at its interface. The PHY side PPI samples the force_rx_mode signal at its interface and assigns it to this variable.
  • 1 : Indicates setting of device into receive mode.
  • 0 : Indicates setting of device into receive mode is disabled.
  • Default value is 0.

  • 1 : Indicates setting of device into transmit mode.
  • 0 : Indicates setting of device into transmit mode is disabled.
  • Default value is 0.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::mark1_on = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indication from Serial layer to PPI layer for Mark1 state on at serial layer Set by Serial layer and reset by the Serial layer.
  • 1 : Assert mark1_on when Serial layer entered into the Mark1 state.
  • 0 : De-assert mark1_on when Serial layer exit from Mark1 state.
  • Default value is 0.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::ppi_enable = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Enable for PPI interface. This signal needs to be set by the protocol layer based on the lanes that are enabled. The PPI model receives and transmits data only when this bit is set. It also drives this value onto the enable pin at its interface.
  • 0 : PPI interface disabled for the lane
  • 1 : PPI interface enabled for the lane
  • Default value is 0

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::ppi_rx_esc_active = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indication from Serial layer to PPI layer that ESC transaction is in progress. PPI layer uses this signal to generate rx_clk_esc by xoring A & C.
  • 0 : ESC transaction not in progress
  • 1 : ESC transaction in progress
  • Default value is 0

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0][3:0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::ppi_rx_trigger = '{ `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES {4'b0}}

Indication from Serial layer to PPI layer about reception of trigger transaction so that PPI can assert the rx_trigger_esc and de-assert it when the serial actually passes the trigger transaction to the PPI i.e. when it moves from mark1 to stop state.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::ppi_trigger_exit = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indication from PPI layer to Serial layer for tx_request_esc de-assertion at PPI layer for TRIGGER mode. Set by PPI layer and reset by the Serial layer for trigger mode only.
  • 1 : Assert ppi_trigger_exit when tx_request_esc de-asserted at PPI layer.
  • 0 : De-assert ppi_trigger_exit when sampled ppi_trigger_exit in the Serial layer.
  • Default value is 0.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::ppi_tx_ready_esc = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indication from Serial layer to PPI layer to assert the tx_ready_esc at the PPI interface. Set by serial layer and reset by the PPI layer.
  • 0 : De-assert tx_ready_esc at PPI I/F. Serial is busy with LPDT transaction.
  • 1 : Assert tx_ready_esc at PPI I/F. Serial has completed the current LPDT transaction and ready for the next one.
  • Default value is 0. Ignored by PPI when LPDT is not in progress.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute

Indication from PPI layer to Serial layer for tx_request_esc de-assertion at PPI layer for ULPS mode. Set by PPI layer and reset by the Serial layer for ulps mode only.
  • 1 : Assert ppi_ulps_mark1_exit when tx_request_esc de-asserted at PPI layer.
  • 0 : De-assert ppi_ulps_mark1_exit when sampled ppi_ulps_mark1_exit in the Serial layer.
  • Default value is 0.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::rx_stopstate = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indicate that respective lane is in stop state or not.
  • Respective lane RX-STOP state will set the respective bit value to one.
  • Respective bit value will be reset to zero once respective lane moves out of RX-STOP state/LP111.
  • rx_stopstate[0] == 1 means that lane zero is in LP111.
  • rx_stopstate[0] == 0 means that lane zero is in not in LP111.
.

Indicates current CPHY(Master/Slave) signal direction of respective lane.
  • FORWARD : Master to Slave.
  • REVERSE : Slave to Master.
  • Default value is FORWARD.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::sot_sync_word_completed = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indication from CPHY serial layer about SYNC word completion during SOT phase. Set and reset by CPHY layer in SOT and SYNC_WORD phase respectively.
  • 1 : Set when SYNC WORD is completed during SOT phase.
  • 0 : Reset when SYNC WORD is received in CPHY layer.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::turn_disable = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indication from APP that BTA is disabled. The APP side PPI layer uses this variable to assert and de-assert the turn_disable signal at its interface. The PHY side PPI samples the turn_disable signal at its interface and assigns it to this variable.
  • 1 : Indication that BTA is disabled.
  • 0 : Indication that BTA is enabled.
  • Default value is 0.

 bit [(SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES-1):0]  attribute
 svt_mipi_cphy_status::tx_stopstate = `SVT_MIPI_CPHY_MAX_NUMBER_OF_LANES'b0

Indicate that respective lane is in stop state or not.
  • Respective lane TX-STOP state will set the respective bit value to one, once required stop duration was executed on lines.
  • Respective bit value will be reset to zero once respective lane moves out of TX-STOP state/LP111.
  • tx_stopstate[0] == 1 means that lane zero is in LP111.
  • tx_stopstate[0] == 0 means that lane zero is in not in LP111.
.
